items.title: Judges in malpractice case received $32,500 in contributions from Baker Botts and counsel
items.summary: Houston’s 14th Court of Appeals upheld a confidential arbitration award favoring Baker Botts after the firm and lead counsel made at least $32,500 in campaign contributions to five judges connected to the matter, including $6,500 to Justice Ken Wise while the appeal was pending. Contributions alone do not establish wrongdoing. Timing raises disclosure, recusal, and appearance questions. Trial judge Phillips previously received an SCJC public warning in an unrelated disclosure matter.
items.eve_read: The dates sit next to a live appeal. That is an appearance question: disclosure, recusal, and whether the other side was told. Money on a docket is not a finding of bribery. It is a reason to look.

items.title: Maverick County Judge Ramsey English Cantu resigns after Chapter 87 suspension
items.summary: Suspended Maverick County Judge Ramsey English Cantu resigned; Commissioners Court accepted. Chapter 87 petition alleged official misconduct and incompetency, including financial-management claims. Court had restricted his social-media commentary. Remainder of term runs through Dec. 31, 2026.
items.eve_read: Removal-track county judges are not SCJC by default. Watch the civil petition, the appointment that follows, and whether any Commission public action ever lands.

items.title: San Antonio Report 2026 voter guide: Supreme Court, Bexar benches, 4th Court of Appeals
items.summary: Public voter guide covering 2026 Texas Supreme Court seats, Bexar County Judge (incumbent Peter Sakai lost the Democratic primary to Ron Nirenberg), 4th Court of Appeals Chief Justice (Rebecca Martinez not seeking reelection; Democrats nominated Antonia Arteaga), and local district benches. General election Nov. 3, 2026.

items.title: Midland County Judge Terry Johnson indicted; Chapter 87 removal pending
items.summary: Johnson surrendered Aug. 19 after indictment on two third-degree felonies. Chapter 87 removal petition filed Aug. 6 (Cause DCV-26-01527). Judge R. Shane Seaton assigned. No public SCJC sanction located as of late August scan.

items.title: Recusal attempt fails in Dallas civil case involving Cowboys owner Jerry Jones
items.summary: Former appellate judge Erin Nowell denied a recusal motion against State District Judge Aiesha Redmond in a civil case alleging misconduct by Jerry Jones. Ruling: movant did not show bias; Texas rules do not allow recusal based solely on a judge’s prior rulings. Plaintiff’s counsel filed a further recusal motion the next day.
items.eve_read: Recusal is the public’s first lever when a bench looks captured. A denial on ‘rulings only’ is legally ordinary. The follow-up motion about staff contact with a commentator is the thread to keep watching — sourced, not speculated.

items.title: Outside prosecutor assigned in Midland Chapter 87 suit against Judge Terry Johnson
items.summary: Judge Ben Woodward assigned Allison Palmer, 51st Judicial District Attorney, to represent the State in the Johnson removal suit.

items.title: Angelina County JP Donald Puckett — Rangers affidavit on training substitution
items.summary: Affidavit reporting: Puckett required an employee to complete Texas Justice Court Training Center coursework in his place. No SCJC public sanction located in the then-current window.

items.title: TEC reminder: Judicial Campaign Fairness Act fundraising window for 2026 cycle
items.summary: Official guidance: candidates covered by the Judicial Campaign Fairness Act (Supreme Court, CCA, courts of appeals, district, statutory county, statutory probate) may accept contributions only in a limited window tied to the Nov. 3, 2026 general election. JCTA must be filed before accepting contributions or spending.

items.title: Angelina County JP Donald Puckett convicted of abuse of official capacity
items.summary: Texas Rangers arrested Precinct 2 JP Puckett on or about Aug. 14. Nolo contendere plea the same day before Judge Todd Kassaw. Convicted and fined $2,290.

items.title: Harris County Judge 2026: Letitia Plummer (D) vs Orlando Sanchez (R) after Hidalgo opts out
items.summary: General election Nov. 3, 2026 for Harris County Judge. Incumbent Lina Hidalgo not running. Democratic runoff winner Letitia Plummer faces Republican Orlando Sanchez. County judge is the administrative head of commissioners court — not a district-court bench — but it is a judicial-titled office Texans ask about.

items.title: Travis County court awards JP Dianne Hensley $640,000 in RFRA suit against SCJC
items.summary: Judge Maya Guerra Gamble ruled for McLennan County JP Dianne Hensley under the Texas Religious Freedom Restoration Act after SCJC publicly warned her in 2019 for declining same-sex wedding ceremonies. Award: $10,000 compensatory plus $630,000 fees; injunction against further discipline on that ground. Commission had withdrawn the sanction in 2024; Texas Supreme Court later amended conduct rules on wedding ceremonies.
items.eve_read: This is a public collision between Commission discipline and a later court/statutory override. Track the injunction’s scope and whether other wedding-ceremony complaints are treated as closed as a class.

items.title: Suspended Fort Bend County Judge K.P. George sentenced after money-laundering conviction
items.summary: Suspended Fort Bend County Judge K.P. George sentenced to 180 days jail, 200 hours community service, and five years probation after a March conviction. Prosecutors: more than $45,000 in campaign funds used personally, including a house down payment. Defense: repayment of candidate loans; political motive alleged. Bond denied; appeal filed. Acting judge Daniel Wong appointed; general election in November.

items.title: CCA Judge David Newell finance report: contributions to other judicial campaigns above $100 cap
items.summary: January campaign-finance report for sitting Court of Criminal Appeals Judge David Newell listed a $4,000 political contribution to ‘Alison Fox for Judge’ in Oct. 2025. Election Code §253.1611 caps such contributions from political funds at $100 per calendar year. Fox said funds were returned. Report also listed $1,000 contributions to other campaigns. Appearance of excess is from the filed report; legality is for TEC/enforcement, not this feed.
items.eve_read: A filed number above a statutory cap is a document fact. Whether it was illegal, refunded, or miscoded is a TEC question. Do not skip the refund claim — and do not skip the original line on the report.
